name: 500 ChatGPT Prompts for Business Owners
short: 500 practical prompts for planning, marketing, sales, customer service and everyday business operations.

name: AI Side Hustles Blueprint

description: Covers practical AI-assisted offers, workflows, pricing and capacity planning, customer acquisition and quality-controlled delivery.

short: A structured guide to remote-job readiness, applications, interviews and safer vacancy screening.
description: A practical guide to identifying suitable remote roles, preparing credible evidence and applications, screening vacancies and preparing for interviews.

short: A practical guide to finding suitable funding opportunities and preparing credible applications.
description: Covers eligibility, funding coverage, application planning, research proposals, references, interviews and scam detection.

short: A practical guide to portfolios, proposals, job screening and safe project delivery on Upwork.

name: BGM Five-Guide Bundle
short: All five BGM guides in one digital collection at a bundled price.
description: Includes the five BGM guides and their supplied companion buyer materials. Digital delivery only; no guaranteed jobs, scholarships, clients or earnings.

name: BGM University Collections-to-Bank Evidence Assistant
short: An offline Excel toolkit for reconciling university receipts, Paystack settlements, bank deposits and cashbook records.
description: An evidence-based reconciliation toolkit for university bursaries and treasury departments. Compare institutional receipts, processor transactions, settlement deductions, bank deposits and cashbook entries. Identify unmatched transactions, investigate differences and document reconciliation evidence.
features: Institutional receipt and Paystack transaction reconciliation
Settlement fees, refunds and net deposit analysis
Clean and fictional demonstration Excel workbooks
Sample CSV files, field mappings and operating guide

name: Campus Bursary — Student Revenue & Treasury (Excel)
short: A macro-free Excel pilot for student billing, receipts, allocations, settlement review and revenue schedules.
description: A set of clean templates and fictional demonstration workbooks for student revenue and treasury workflows. Targets Microsoft 365 Excel for Windows 64-bit and uses one authorised writer at a time. It is a pilot and requires institution-specific review before financial use.
features: First-year amount includes annual licence and standard setup
Student records, fee schedules, invoices and instalment dates
Receipts, allocations, unapplied balances, credits and refund schedules
Settlement matching with manual review and visible exceptions
Ageing, statements, clearance and cashier handover schedules
Revenue dashboard and printable receipt templates
Clean customer templates, synthetic demo workbook and user guide

name: Campus Bursary — Bursary Operations & Control (Excel)
short: A macro-free Excel pilot for budgets, commitments, payables, advances, grants, assets and payroll checking.
description: A set of clean templates and fictional demonstration workbooks for bursary operations and expenditure control. Targets Microsoft 365 Excel for Windows 64-bit and uses one authorised writer at a time. It is a pilot and requires institution-specific review before financial use.
features: First-year amount includes annual licence and standard setup
Budgets, signed revisions, virements and commitment liquidation
Supplier bills, payment schedules and advance retirements
Restricted-project cash schedules and asset depreciation schedules
Payroll import checking and period comparison, not statutory payroll
Expenditure dashboard and printable voucher templates
Clean customer templates, synthetic demo workbook and user guide

name: Campus Bursary — Full Excel Suite
short: Packages A and B plus shared institution setup, manual journals, trial balance and control-account comparisons.
description: A combined pilot with the student revenue and bursary operations workbooks, plus a shared full-suite workbook. The full workbook includes manual journal inputs and mapped trial-balance and control-account comparisons; it does not automatically post every operational schedule to the ledger or produce statutory financial statements. Targets Microsoft 365 Excel for Windows 64-bit and one authorised writer at a time. Requires institution-specific accounting review before financial use.
features: First-year amount includes annual licence and standard setup
All delivered schedules from Student Revenue & Treasury and Bursary Operations & Control
Shared institution configuration and master-record structure
Manual journal headers and lines with balanced-entry checks
Trial balance and mapped control-account comparisons
Financial statement generation only where approved mappings support it
Clean customer templates, synthetic demo workbooks and user guide
